test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: You are going to figure out everything.
You are going to figre out everything.
You are going to figrue out everything.
You are going to figure out everrything.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1: "**You are going to figure out everything.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**figure**" is spelled **correctly**, with "ie" in the middle.
 
• The word "**everything**" is spelled c
